Implementi e integri MCP per la gestione di contesti, tool e fonti di conoscenza strutturate. Integri chatbot e agenti direttamente nei prodotti Jet HR e nei tool interni - non come demo o per esplorare, ma come funzionalità in produzione. Prepari e pulisci i dati per l'ingestion in sistemi RAG e knowledge base AI: qualità, struttura, aggiornamento continuo. Mantieni le knowledge base attive e aggiornate, con pipeline automatizzate di update e versioning. Contribuisci all'infrastruttura della data platform a supporto dei workload AI - sei parte integrante del team che la costruisce. Come Lavoriamo ‍ Il team Data di Jet HR non è un team di supporto. È una funzione strategica che costruisce la piattaforma dati su cui gira il prodotto e i prodotti AI che lo estendono. Data platform prima di tutto. Lavoriamo su una piattaforma scalabile e robusta: architettura, automazione, data products. Niente one-off, niente workaround. Full stack mindset. Non aspetti che qualcun altro sblocchi qualcosa. Hai la piena ownership del tuo pezzo, dalla logica all'infrastruttura. Tech-first. Il team è composto da data engineers, AI engineers e analytics engineers. Collaboriamo strettamente con prodotto, payroll e operations per trasformare i dati in asset strategici. Niente task banali. Non esistono report manuali da tenere in vita. Automatizziamo, ottimizziamo, costruiamo soluzioni che durano. Tech stack DBT · Snowflake · Python · Metabase · DltHub · Apache Airflow · Docker · AWS · LangChain Chi stiamo cercando 3+ anni di esperienza nella costruzione di soluzioni di data science o machine learning, di cui almeno 1 su AI (RAG, agent frameworks, LLM in produzione). Python solido. Non un "lo conosco", ma lo usi ogni giorno e conosci bene le librerie AI - LangChain e dintorni. ML/AI hands-on. Hai sviluppato, fatto tuning e deployato modelli reali. Sai cosa funziona fuori da un notebook. Cosa offriamo €45.000 – €65.000 di RAL. Full remote. Per davvero. Puoi lavorare da dove vuoi, basta che sia in una timezone compatibile con l’Italia. Se vuoi, il nostro ufficio a Milano è pronto ad accoglierti. Due volte l’anno abbiamo un meetup di 3 giorni, tutto pagato da Jet. Ownership di quello che fai. Il ruolo del product manager è ripartito tra software engineer e designer. Non hai spec iper-dettagliate, non sei un mero esecutore. Sei tu responsabile dell’output finale. Impatto concreto. Siamo una start-up, ognuno dà un contributo essenziale allo sviluppo dei prodotti e alla crescita di Jet. Il tuo lavoro fa la differenza per migliaia di clienti. Start-up environment . Non è una startup qualsiasi, ma una ben finanziata e zeppa di talenti. In 6 mesi vedrai ed imparerai cose che altrove forse vedresti in anni, con un altissimo livello di responsabilità e coinvolgimento. Processo di selezione Screening call — 30 minuti con Head of Data Task asincrono — ~3/4 ore Tech interview — 60 minuti con Head of Data Final interview — 60 minuti con il team, per il fitting

Fast-paced, people-driven, and globally connected, we empower businesses to build teams without borders. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to deliver impactful solutions. Review code, mentor teammates, and continuously improve engineering standards. Troubleshoot production issues and continuously enhance system performance, reliability, and scalability. We value pragmatic decision-making, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and shipping high-quality software that solves real business problems. Our Training & Development Allowance helps you continue expanding your skills. Stay connected: Take part in exciting annual team meetups. Diversity is our superpower: We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. Benefits vary depending on location due to local laws and regulations. At WorkMotion, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations during the recruitment process, simply let our Recruitment Team know at Jobs@WorkMotion.com . We're here to support you every step of the way.

review_candidates.title: Flight Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Intuitive Machines: Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on-orbit operations, and safety. About The Position Intuitive Machines is seeking a Flight Software Engineer to support the Landsat 10 mission under the OMES III contract at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, MD. This position requires hybrid on-site support and the ability to obtain and maintain a NASA badge. The selected candidate will join a multidisciplinary flight software team responsible for the development, integration, test, verification, and sustainment of mission-critical spacecraft flight software supporting one of NASA's flagship Earth observation missions. The successful candidate will participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements development through flight software delivery, integration, system testing, launch support, and on-orbit operations. This position offers the opportunity to work alongside NASA civil servants, flight software developers, systems engineers, software assurance organizations, and spacecraft hardware teams in the development of highly reliable spaceflight systems. Responsibilities Design, develop, integrate, and test embedded flight software for spacecraft avionics systems. Support all phases of the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture design, implementation, unit testing, integration, verification, validation, and maintenance. Develop software for real-time spacecraft applications operating on embedded processors and flight-qualified operating systems. Participate in software peer reviews, design reviews, and formal NASA lifecycle reviews. Collaborate with hardware engineers, systems engineers, mission operations personnel, and software assurance teams. Support software integration activities with spacecraft avionics and communications hardware. Develop and maintain software documentation, test procedures, verification reports, and technical memoranda. Investigate software anomalies and support troubleshooting efforts during integration and test activities. Support Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V), Software Quality Assurance (SQA), and mission assurance activities. Assist with flight software readiness assessments and mission operations support as required. Education Required Qualifications & Experience : Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience 15+ years of experience developing software for embedded or real-time systems. Familiarity with NPR 7150.2 Experience supporting the complete software development lifecycle from requirements through acceptance testing. Experience developing software within structured engineering processes utilizing industry-recognized standards. Desired Qualifications Experience supporting NASA, DoD, NOAA, or commercial spaceflight programs. Flight software development experience for spacecraft, instruments, or ground-support systems. Familiarity with software acquisition and government flight projects. Experience using: IBM DOORS or equivalent requirements management tools TDMS or equivalent configuration/data management systems Git, SVN, or other software configuration management tools Experience leading small software development teams or technical task groups. Knowledge of spacecraft command and data handling systems. Experience supporting environmental testing, integration and test campaigns, or launch preparation activities. Preferred Competencies Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative NASA and contractor environment. Self-motivated with strong attention to detail and quality. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced mission environment. US EEO Statement: Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
